diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says Analog, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: DFRobot schematic 'Piezo Disk Vibration Sensor' rev 2.0 (2015-10-23): on output connector J1, pin 1 is the signal net shared with the disc (J2 pin 1), D1 5.1V zener and R1 1M to ground; pin 2 is unconnected; pin 3 goes to the ground symbol. So pin 1 = Analog. The DFRobot pinout drawing labels the connector top to bottom as 'GND, NC(empty), Analog', so the second reading took the drawing's top label for pin 1. The drawing lists the pins in the reverse of their numbers, but it does not contradict the schematic.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says GND, datasheet reading says Analog
diffs.evidence: Same schematic (rev 2.0): J1 pin 3 is wired to the ground symbol, and J1 pin 1 carries the piezo/zener/1M signal. So pin 3 = GND. The pinout drawing (https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/85eee3c8969440c59ddb9aa8b2f51a2f/wikien/2d24095eba06f7e5b9bf7282ad8b5cbb_0x0.png) lists 'GND / NC(empty) / Analog' top to bottom, which is pins 3, 2, 1, and agrees with the schematic.
